question.text: In the reaction, $\mathrm{A} \rightarrow$ products, If the concentration of the reactant is doubled rate of the reaction remains unchanged. The order of the reaction with respect to A is

solution.text:
$r_1=k[A]^n$ and $r_2=k[2 A]^n$
$\because \quad \mathrm{r}_1=\mathrm{r}_2 \quad \therefore \mathrm{k}[\mathrm{A}]^{\mathrm{n}}=\mathrm{k}(2[\mathrm{~A}])^{\mathrm{n}}$
or, $\quad 2^n=1$
or, $2^{\mathrm{n}}=2^{\circ} \Rightarrow \mathrm{n}=0$
It is a zero order reaction.
